name: Scene Counter · 场景计数
description: Count the nodes in the current scene.
source: StoryTree.register({ count({ project, sceneId, language }) { const count = project.nodes.filter(node => node.sceneId === sceneId).length; return { message: language === 'en' ? count + ' nodes in this scene' : '当前场景有 ' + count + ' 个节点' }; } });
